newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers unchanged, demand very low.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers unchanged, demand very low.

text.p: European bunker prices were unchanged on Monday and demand was almost non-existent with players in both Britain and the U.S. away on public holidays, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were still quoted at around $83/$84 fob.
Total ARA demand barely was less than 10,000 tonnes by most assessments.
"We've got maybe 6,000 tonnes of demand and half of that is from (a single shipping firm)," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices settled at around $90 fob.
"There seems to be a slightly downward trend, but we were offering low late last week. The activity level is quite moderate," one Med supplier said.
